title: The Tipsy Uncle
offer: Uncle Sven of Frosttorp sang and danced all night, and now he can't find his way home! He is very merry and a little wobbly. Row him home to Arne, please.

steps.load_say: Uncle Sven: Ho ho! Two little vikings with a boat! Let us sing on the way!
steps.say: Uncle Sven! Singing all the way, I hear? Come in, sleep it off. Thank you, girls!

fact: The vikings loved songs and riddles; at a feast, everybody had to sing.
